_meta.usage: landline in national form, 0 + area digit + six digits: 01 234567, 07-765432, (05) 123456, or just the code (07); drop a leading +961 and add the 0
_meta.miss_note: not a Lebanese landline: a landline is 0 + one area digit + six digits; 03 xxxxxx and eight-digit 70/71/76/78/79/81 numbers are mobile; 02 is no longer used
source: Telecommunications Regulatory Authority, Current National Numbering Plan (cited by that article)
